* 9. sql-query-public
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: web/sql-query-public
:FILE: resources/packages/web/sql/impls.clj
:LINE: 153
:MINS: 1.5
:END:

Executes a caller-owned PostgreSQL SELECT and returns only explicitly named columns. The database password enters a [[file:glossary.org::#term/secret][secret]] slot but is consumed at the JDBC boundary. Unlike a raw ~:sql-query~ result, the allowlisted row maps can enter a plain JSON handler. The author must review the selected columns before exposing the handler.

- source :: [[file:../../../resources/packages/web/sql/impls.clj::(defbase sql-query-public][resources/packages/web/sql/impls.clj:153]]

Exposes pre-write validation as one [[file:glossary.org::#term/base-function][base function]] returning a rejection reason or nil. The surrounding CRUD routes compose parsing, validation, and application as [[file:glossary.org::#term/graph-function][graph functions]]. Reference-cycle, [[file:glossary.org::#term/inheritance][inheritance]], override, and closed-list checks remain shared with the CRUD implementation.

:FILE: resources/packages/web/crud-parse/fns.edn
:LINE: 51
:MINS: 1.4
:END:

Composes the native form codec with graph policy: repeated keys keep their last value, and a body without fields becomes an empty text map. The native codec avoids regex input-length limits for large values such as edited assets.

* 13. hiccup-element
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: web/hiccup-element

:LINE: 27
:MINS: 0.9

Constructs a [[file:glossary.org::#term/hiccup][Hiccup]] element from tag, attributes, and children. Graph-composed pages use it to build markup, including ~data-action~ attributes handled by the browser runtime and [[file:glossary.org::#term/htmx][HTMX]] attributes requesting [[file:glossary.org::#term/htmx][server-rendered fragments]]. This creates markup; browser interaction still requires the corresponding runtime.

:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: web/encoding-acceptable-fn
:FILE: resources/packages/web/http/impls.clj
:LINE: 146
:MINS: 0.7
:END:

Parses whether an ~Accept-Encoding~ token accepts one coding. The surrounding ~:process-response~ [[file:glossary.org::#term/graph-function][graph function]] decides whether compression is appropriate and prepares headers and body. The ~:pick-encoding~ graph chooses brotli, gzip or identity using this parser.

* 19. fn-type-args-fn
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: web/fn-type-args-fn
:FILE: resources/packages/web/crud-types/impls.clj
:LINE: 83
:MINS: 1.0
:END:

Reads a callable type's argument map through the canonical type accessor; non-callable types return nil. The ~candidate-fit~ composition in [[file:../../../resources/packages/web/crud-types/fns.edn][crud-types/fns.edn]] counts these arguments and ranks already-admissible candidates: ~:exact~ matches the supplied count, ~:captures~ needs additional [[file:glossary.org::#term/capture][captured input]], and ~:ignores~ consumes fewer parameters. Value [[file:glossary.org::#term/slot][slots]] compare with zero; identity slots are exact. Ranking changes display order, not whether the type checker admits a candidate.

- source :: [[file:../../../resources/packages/web/crud-types/impls.clj::(defbase fn-type-args-fn][resources/packages/web/crud-types/impls.clj:83]]

:LINE: 58
:MINS: 2.7

Synchronizes function definitions into a specified branch for [[file:glossary.org::#term/mcp][MCP]] and bundle-import callers. It uses the same synchronization checks as packaged definitions and invalidates the target branch's [[file:glossary.org::#term/compiled-registry][compiled registry]]. The target may differ from the branch carrying the HTTP request.
